messages.subject: ggplot2 user survey - thanks!
parts:
Hi all,

Thanks for the fantastic response to the ggplot2 users survey - I've
already received over 400 responses! If you haven't filled it out
already, it's not too late -
http://hadley.wufoo.com/forms/ggplot2-survey/.

Either way you might be interested in seeing a summary of the
responses so far -
http://hadley.wufoo.com/reports/ggplot2-user-survey/. I'll work on
pulling together a better report in the next week or so.

Thanks again!
